scripts.db:migrate:local: docker compose up -d postgres --wait && docker exec -i gdg-jobs-postgres psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS auth; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION auth.uid() RETURNS uuid AS \$\$ SELECT NULL::uuid \$\$ LANGUAGE sql STABLE;" && for f in packages/database/migrations/*.sql; do echo "-- applying $f"; docker exec -i gdg-jobs-postgres psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate: echo 'Sem Supabase CLI linkado neste ambiente. Veja packages/database/README.md — SQL Editor do dashboard ou `supabase db push`. Para validar localmente: npm run db:migrate:local' && exit 0
scripts.db:seed: docker exec -i gdg-jobs-postgres psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < packages/database/seeds/jobs.sql
